# Vendored MapLibre distribution

These are the unmodified browser distribution assets and licence from the official npm package
`maplibre-gl@5.24.0`:

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `maplibre-gl.js` | `45a9b07a9189ce56054c620a947ccf41e291e58c95e9b61533b740aaa65ee5cb` |
| `maplibre-gl.css` | `ab1e70d59ec40465bae7e7030da2f3ccf28133fd502e62bd598eefbadfd7a732` |

`MAPLIBRE-LICENSE.txt` is the package's BSD-3-Clause licence and bundled notices. When upgrading,
copy all three files from one exact npm package version, update the HTML query version, hashes,
tests and mapping documentation together, then run the live property-map check.
